headline: Hindustan Composites, Canara Robeco, HCL and Bansal Wire set corporate action dates
hook: Record date locks in payouts and split
summary: Hindustan Composites and Canara Robeco AMC have declared interim dividends of ₹21 and ₹2 per share, respectively, with October 16, 2026, set as the record date. HCL Technologies has announced a dividend of ₹12 per share for the same date. Additionally, Bansal Wire Industries has scheduled a five-for-one stock split with the identical record date. Investors must purchase the shares today to be eligible for these corporate actions.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders receive declared dividends and split shares
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / late buyers miss out

headline: Hindustan Composites fixes record date for dividend
hook: Dividend payout date set for October
summary: Hindustan Composites has announced that October 16, 2026, will serve as the record date for an upcoming dividend. Eligible shareholders as of this date will receive the declared payout. Dividend declarations provide routine cash returns for long-term investors holding the stock. Retail shareholders should check their demat account eligibility ahead of the record date.
whats_next: Dividend payout on or after October 16, 2026
why_it_matters: Cash payout incoming for existing shareholders on record.

headline: Hindustan Composites announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board proceedings at Hindustan Composites
summary: Hindustan Composites Limited has submitted the official outcome of its board meeting held on October 12, 2026, to the stock exchanges. Such routine filings are standard compliance procedures for listed companies. Indian retail investors holding shares in the company should check exchange portals for any specific corporate actions disclosed in the filing. The announcement affects only the company's shareholders tracking procedural compliance.
why_it_matters: Check exchange filings for any specific corporate actions.

headline: Hindustan Composites declares special interim dividend of Rs 21 per share
hook: Special payout for Hindustan Composites holders
summary: The board of directors of Hindustan Composites Limited announced a special interim dividend of Rs 21 per equity share following a meeting held on October 12, 2026. This cash distribution provides an immediate return to shareholders on record. For retail investors holding the stock, the payout translates to a direct cash inflow, rewarding current participation without altering the company's core operations.
whats_next: Record date for dividend eligibility to be announced
why_it_matters: Immediate cash dividend credited directly to eligible shareholders.
